notes: Portal pack for Jeremie/Marc via LiveHire. No outbound email in this tick.
email_body:
Hello Diona hiring team,

I am applying for the Graduate Engineer role in Brisbane advertised on your LiveHire careers page.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 (road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD) after a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. From 2019 to 2020 I worked in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and subdivision finishing works, coordinating crews, inspections and site records. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and interstate project work.

Your Brisbane graduate role on utility civil construction, including pipelines, drainage and concrete works, matches the kind of hands-on project delivery I want to learn properly. I have not yet worked on Australian water, sewer or gas pipeline projects, so I would treat that as a learning curve under your team.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Happy to complete the LiveHire application steps or any further screening you need.

Marc Darenz Masarate
